research_question: Can the public Live-seq data support a leakage-controlled comparison of basal-transcriptome-only and pre-intervention-cell-cycle-conditioned prediction of downstream LPS-induced Tnf-mCherry response?

outcome_availability_rule.requirement: finite and non-missing for every selected cohort member
outcome_availability_rule.rule: Outcome availability is evaluated only after cohort membership is frozen.

linkage_rule: Every selected metadata sample_ID must occur exactly once in the count-matrix columns. Repeated measurements of the same cell must remain in one split.

phase_representation.secondary: categorical phase derived from training-fitted scoring procedure

future_model_comparison.phase_conditioned: same basal transcriptome representation plus pre-intervention cell-cycle representation -> mCherry.log.slope

amendment_note: The initial feasibility draft incorrectly included response availability in cohort membership. This amendment removes target-dependent selection before any model fitting or performance estimation.
non_claims: This audit does not evaluate X-Cell.
This audit does not establish causal timing.
This audit does not establish biological safety or therapeutic efficacy.
